steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehehe, you're finally here... I've been waiting a while, and I was getting bored.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on in, didn't you want to "interrogate" me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Chief?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoa! That's bright!
The white light suddenly illuminates a young woman in the dark, squinting against the brightness.
I'm sorry, do you want me to turn it off?
options: I'm sorry, do you want me to turn it off?

choices.text: I'm sorry, do you want me to turn it off?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No no, it's like that on purpose, to deter us bad guys.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You, though, Chief, look a little inexperienced...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is this your first time interrogating someone? Do you know what to do?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha, that's so gentle, Chief. Really classic "good cop." Looks like you know what you're doing.
There is no laughter in her eyes. Even though she was never a cute and sweet girl, her anger at this moment seems extraordinary.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oho, very imposing! Haughty and cold like an interrogator should be. Don't lose that energy!
There is no laughter in her eyes. Even though she was never a cute and sweet girl, her anger at this moment seems extraordinary.
It's as if the person before you isn't the Sinner who fought beside you, shoulder to shoulder, but a hostile and intimidating criminal.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let's get down to it, Chief. What do you want to ask? Do you want a record of my accomplishments in the Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The Public Security Bureau has an extreeeemely thick file all about me. Shall we take a look?

From N.F. 100 to N.F. 109, Hella committed 26 thefts, 35 scams, 5 kidnappings...There are even 15 prison breaks on her record.

steps.speaker: Officer A's Note
steps.content: She used sympathy for her own wounds. She played sympathy and lied to help her buddies get away with crimes... Remember, there's no such thing as "innocence" in Syndicate. They all grow up to be vicious and cunning criminals.

steps.speaker: Officer B's Note
steps.content: That dirty rat! She's treating the Public Security Bureau like she can just come and go as she pleases?! No matter what we do to her she's still unrepentant, let's just leave her to die in the Syndicate!
It's a record that makes your eyes water. If this was a normal criminal career for the weak of the Syndicate, you could see how the district had deteriorated to this point.
It's just that nowhere in this record has any explanation of Hella using her Sinner ability.
Quite the opposite, it was a record of Hella constantly being arrested and injured. She came across as a very weak girl.
You never had any special power?
options: You never had any special power?

choices.text: You never had any special power?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You figured it out! I wasn't born a Sinner, and the transformation was a long process.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Next, you're going to ask me: When did the transformation happen, what happened, who was involved... right?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Your predecessors had already asked those questions countless times.
So will you tell me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Chief, you've collected all that evidence, why don't you try and guess?
She softly taps her temple with her finger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: "Fix your attitude! Everything you say may be used to evaluate your danger level and how to contain you. If you don't want to be punished, answer honestly!"

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Fine, Chief, the criminal Hella awaits your judgment.

FAC suspects that you are an illegally, artificially created Sinner.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh? Hm, how do I put this... I'm not educated, I don't really know what human experimentation means.
Well, it just so happens that what you're holding in your hand may have something to do with "human experimentation."

This is data recovered from a Mania weapon core. The core experiment mentioned is... Subject No. 327. That's you, right?

The experiment was a success, and had an unexpected benefit... regeneration ability... Syndicate girl...
It's not likely there's another one like her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whew—Where did you get that? That deserves a round of applause.
Tell me the details
This report was found near a Mania weapon. I am very interested in the connection between them.
What experiments did they perform on you? What was the goal? Was it to create a Sinner? Why did you participate?

Was it... of your own free will?
That question, you don't ask.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Deduction time is over, and now you're going to ask some questions?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't waste your time, I'm not going to tell you anything.
For a moment, only the harsh sounds of the monitoring equipment echo in the interrogation room, and the atmosphere becomes even worse than it started.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why are you surprised? Did you think locking me up in a place like this, putting the cuffs on me and acting a little sweet would make me obediently explain everything?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't look down on me! I've been arrested enough that I got tired of your games a long time ago. You're all the same!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you afraid of me? Hate me? Because I'm a criminal, a Sinner? Are you going to beat me next?!
Her anger suddenly explodes, too honest to cover up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn thing... I should never have saved you like an idiot, taken hits for you...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If I had known you were like this, I would have beaten you with a hammer, you idiot!

She seems extremely fierce. All monitoring instruments are alerting, reminding you that things will be difficult to handle if you don't make a proper response. But you notice more subtle emotions hidden beneath her intense overreaction.
It's not the first time you have glimpsed the cracks in her heart. Now you know what to do...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Huh?
Together, we beat up the gangsters that bullied you, fighting shoulder to shoulder for so long. Yet I put you in this interrogation room.
You thought we should be more than an interrogator and a criminal, but I let you down. Is that why you became so angry?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you talking about? No, it's not...
All of her eloquence falls away. It seems like she hadn't been aware of her own feelings. After a moment, she seems at a loss.
I'm sorry I was so slow.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you talking about! Don't start acting all affectionate, I still don't...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Wait, what are you doing, stay back!
She sees you stand, and leans backwards as if she's frightened. If she weren't handcuffed, she would probably jump up and run away.
Do you want me to untie your hands?
options: Do you want me to release your hands?

choices.text: Do you want me to release your hands?

steps.content: We've been through a lot together, we don't have to go through this whole process. We should be more like friends.
You've helped me a lot, and I don't want anything to make you unhappy.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop, stop! This is getting indecent, I'm gonna yell! ****, did you come here today just to disgust me?
steps.female_content: Stop, stop! Shame on you! The big bullying the small, eh? ****, did you come here today just to disgust me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Listen, it's a question of manners. What you're talking about has nothing to do with friends! I'm just mad that you don't know how to be grateful!
Thank you very much.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Still disgusting. I'm going back. Help!
She makes noise for a while, but eventually quiets down. Although she's a bit indignant and distressed, her earlier hostility is gone.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ha... hahahaha... you're right.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You've already got good posture for an interrogator, New Chief.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So come on, bring out your torture implements and we'll see if you can pry my mouth open.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm not going to die anyway, and we've got time...
She's provoking you, but at this very moment you realize that you won't be able to get a drop of intelligence out of her...

You tried to play the part of a professional interrogator, but you couldn't get anything out of her.
Should you be more fierce towards her? You've been through so much together, you probably couldn't bring yourself to do it. You don't have that kind of ice-cold relationship.
What kind of mood that is driving this resistance to your interrogation?

Next time, maybe you should try and start from here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Forget it... I already knew you were a freak.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Nobody with all their marbles would ever talk with a Sinner.
This is a compliment. Sort of.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I don't need friends.
With this, she hardens up again.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?
Your partners in crime? You were always taking the rap for them.
At least, she definitely wouldn't do the same for you.
After a moment of silence, Hella's eyes become as cold as ice, or rather—disgusted.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those guys weren't friends, we just used each other for what we needed.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They needed a minor to help them get away, and I needed to survive.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: In the Syndicate, without "friends," an orphan like me can just die in a dark corner.
But they abandoned you every time, left you to get beaten in the Public Security Bureau.
If it was just a mutual arrangement... Well, the Hella I know would never take that, so why did you go along with them reluctantly?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm very open-hearted.
She's putting on a brave face again. But after a moment, she looks away and avoids your gaze.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...When I was little, I still thought that if they needed me, if I was useful, I could become their "friend."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No one ever told me what a friend was.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't look at me like that, it's all in the past. I was an idiot, but after I was sold for money, I woke up.
What happened?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Nothing hard to explain. It's just like you all thought, human experimentation.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That year, the Syndicate brought in a few strange researchers who were looking for helpless orphans and were willing to pay big. They took them away to perform so-called superhuman experiments.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: My "friends" tricked me and sold me as an experimental subject.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: For beer money.
There is an unbearable silence. The tragic descriptions in the Parma report are swimming through your mind.
What kind of experiments?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I don't remember. Needles every day, strange drugs, electric shocks, making us drink some kind of black mud—Oh yeah, that was something that leaked out of Corruptors. Then they'd record our reactions.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If I cried, some perverts would get really excited. That was when I decided I would be just like them. I would never shed another tear.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I gritted my teeth through it all, until one day the place they cut me closed up all of a sudden. They said I had transformed into a superhuman.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, I am a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But I can't be sure it was the experiments that did it. In the end, most of the people who were experimented on along with me died.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's definitely because of my superhuman will.
She smiles, but you feel uncomfortable.
...And then? Was it over?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How could it be over? Even if it wasn't the ability they really wanted, those bastards could definitely find another use.
The report says that you were treated as consumable material, and some monster would torture you and attack you with blades.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't call her that, and anyway, aren't I a monster too, the way I can't die?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ha, that's right. The researchers thought that contact between monsters could further strengthen special powers, and my unlimited regeneration ability made me an excellent punching bag.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Every day, they would cut me, burn me, see how much I could take, see how fast I could recover. Those brutes found ways to prolong the experiment.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't ask for specifics, you couldn't handle hearing about it.
You think about the mysterious force called Parma, their relationship with Mania weapons, and what they did to Hella. You think about how she was only...
You feel your blood rising.
I won't let them get away with this.
options: I won't let them get away with this.

choices.text: I won't let them get away with this.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What are you mad about? It doesn't make any sense, it doesn't have anything to do with you.
But it has something to do with you.
options: But it has something to do with you.

choices.text: But it has something to do with you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pff, what do you know about it? I'm not going to sit here and let you pity me!
She whooshes back, her face alert, and raises her head to glare at you, but she seems at a loss.
Is she putting on her "bad guy" face again? Or does she just not want you to worry? Anyway, once she has pulled herself together, she clears her throat and begins to speak.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: All right, don't worry like a mother hen. I am a smart and cute and strong and clever young woman, and I wasn't going to be beaten that easily.

steps.speaker: The flickering of the lights, the timing of the PA interruptions, the quickening rhythm of the music, and the sequence of the rooms. None of it is random. They're all working together to direct your attention, intensify the stimulation, and amplify the emotional responses.
steps.content: It took me less than a year to escape their clutches, thanks to my superpower and smarts!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And there were good things about it too. Once I became a Sinner, I could take care of myself. I didn't have to do what everyone else wanted, and life in the Syndicate was good.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I could go out and beat them up for a change! What a release!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why do you still have such a worried face? Let me tell you what my motto is.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: "What don't kill you makes you stronger." Remember? And I can't be killed, so I only ever get stronger.
Cough. Thanks, I got it.
You resist the urge to correct her grammar, though you'll give her a refresher when you have a chance.
The joke pulls you out of your hellish reverie, and she looks more relaxed too.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So, there's nothing to worry about.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm a Syndicate rat, who can't be killed and can't be held. I'm free, and soon even this place won't be able to hold me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: When that day comes, don't cry over me. After all, power shifts.
Looking at her face, if you didn't know better, you would assume her rating is increased to S.
But whether it was escaping the lab or cowing the Syndicate, Hella's accomplishments are astonishing—her strength is incomparable.
Even her attitude toward her abominable past is surprisingly calm and positive. You can't help but feel that maybe Hella gained something more important.
Something like a real friend.

The bloodthirsty monster designated <color=#e45515>No. 99</color> participated in the experiment on Hella, the monster who carved on her thousands of times... That Sinner Lab...
Where did you meet?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Why do you ask?
In the lab?
Hella's expression shifts from suspicion to alertness. She clearly knows what you have guessed...
If her new partner really is the monster in the Parma Report—the terrifying being with the uncontrollable madness who hurt Hella so many times...
Why would you choose to be with her? The monster who harmed you so many times could easily keep hurting you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't call her a monster. This has nothing to do with you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What, do you want to catch her too? Keep her captive like me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't even think about it. I'm not telling you anything about her.
Her gaze cools down. Suddenly, the distance between you feels even greater.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: I'm just worried about you.
I'm not like those researchers, I don't want to see you get hurt again.
She starts, and her watchful face looks guilty for a moment. She grits her teeth and buries her head, away from your eyes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...It was better when you treated me like a criminal.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't worry about me so much. I think... There's been a misunderstanding.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We aren't friends, and can't be friends. It was doomed from the start.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: But—|Why?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Look in your hands. Friends would never limit each other's freedom, but your existence is our greatest shackle.

This was a successful interrogation. You have obtained a lot of precious information about Hella's creation, her ability, and the human experimentation she was a part of, as well as her loyalty and attention to her friend.
You even think that your relationship with her has progressed a little—even if it is an illusion.

As for her valued, deeply suspicious friend, you still don't know a thing.
